argv: cp -p "$1/gate.sh" "$1/drift/gate.sh"; bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$1/drift/gate.sh" --defects "$1/done.spec" --suite "bash \"\$MUTANT\" --selftest; rc=\$?; if [ \"\$DEFECT_ID\" = K1 ]; then printf \"# drift\\n\" >> \"\$TARGET\"; fi; exit \$rc" --workdir "$1/drift-run" >"$1/drift.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$1/drift.log"; echo "[drift] exit=$rc headline-lines=$(grep -cE "^MUTATE: (DONE|DEGRADED)" "$1/drift.log") evidence-line=$(grep -c "^MUTATE_EVIDENCE" "$1/drift.log")"; echo; cp -p "$1/gate.sh" "$1/alias/defects.tsv"; sha256sum "$1/alias/defects.tsv"; bash tools/mutate-and-run.sh --target "$1/alias/defects.tsv" --defects "$1/done.spec" --suite "bash \"\$MUTANT\" --selftest" --workdir "$1/alias" >"$1/alias.log" 2>&1; rc=$?; cat "$1/alias.log"; echo "[alias] exit=$rc"; echo "--- original now:"; cat "$1/alias/defects.tsv"; cmp -s "$1/alias/defects.tsv" "$1/gate.sh" && echo "original-intact" || echo "original-OVERWRITTEN"; cmp -s "$1/alias/pristine.defects.tsv" "$1/gate.sh" && echo "pristine-holds-original-bytes"
